content.comment_body: I recently upgraded [product_name] from [version_no] to [version_no]. I find the font used in the new version quite unattractive, especially in the menus and sidebar areas. I preferred the font from the previous version. Is there any way to change the font in [product_name], perhaps through an .ini file or the registry? Or is it not possible to adjust this setting? Thanks for any information.
No, it's not possible to change the system font.
However, you can adjust scaling in the Options-General menu, which might improve the appearance slightly.

analysis.insight_summary: Users express disappointment with the new font style in [product_name] after upgrading to [version_no]. There is no way to directly customize or revert the font using settings or configuration files, which limits user control over the interface appearance. While scaling options offer a minor improvement, direct font modification is not currently supported.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for the ability to customize or revert font styles within the software, ideally through settings, configuration files, or registry changes.
